overview_description.description: Taxdoo provides software solutions for automated sales tax compliance and financial accounting in e-commerce. The platform collects and evaluates transaction data from marketplaces and other systems to automatically submit sales tax reports. Taxdoo also offers accounting features with DATEV compatibility and services specifically for tax advisors managing e-commerce mandates.
